serverInfo.name: OpenAI-Decisions
serverInfo.title: OpenAI Decisions
serverInfo.description: Evaluate text, documents, images, and SharePoint folder documents with typed condition probabilities, fixed choices, and rubric scores using OpenAI Decisions.

instructions: Use Decisions for typed classifications and rubric scores, not free-form answers or field extraction. Supply inputText and/or documentUrls/imageUrls as evidence. Documents use the existing RAG/resource text extraction pipeline. Images are downloaded and sent natively as inline base64; at most 128 images are supported. SharePoint and OneDrive links use the existing authenticated downloads and require a delegated Microsoft token and consent. documentUrls also accepts SharePoint/OneDrive for Business folder links: folders are detected automatically, all pages of direct-child files are included, and subfolders are never traversed. If any folder is supplied, every resolved document (including explicit file URLs) is evaluated independently using the same questions; inline text and explicit image URLs are shared context. Duplicate drive items are evaluated once. The structured result has mode per_document, folders, totalDocuments, succeeded, failed, message, and results; each result contains url and name plus either the complete raw response or an error. Individual extraction/API errors do not stop other documents; discovery/authorization/shared-context errors and cancellation stop the operation. Empty folders return an empty results array without an API call. Without folders, document evidence is combined and the existing raw response shape is unchanged. Supply an MCP progress token to receive discovery, per-document processing, success/failure counts, and completion notifications. Predicate evaluates a condition; choice selects one of 2–255 distinct string values; score evaluates ordered labels with indices starting at zero. Optional description arrays must align with the values/labels arrays. For batches, boolean/mixed-type choices, or complex official definitions, use questions_url with a JSON file containing a single object with a nonempty questions array. Only that array is imported; the file's input, model, and other settings are ignored. Independent questions share the supplied evidence within each evaluation and preserve order. Use separate requests when a question depends on an earlier answer. Each raw response includes refusal answers, probabilities, confidence, model, and usage. Calibrate thresholds for your application; probability/confidence are not guarantees. The current default model is gpt-6-luna.
